title: Lower mass bound at a tangent point: liminf t^{−n} μ_V(B_t(x)) ≥ θ ω_n (eventual form)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U, x ∈ ℝ^N, T ∈ G(N,n), θ ∈ ℝ with HasTangentPlane V x T θ. Then for every c ∈ [0,∞] with c < ofReal(θ) · ω_n (ω_n = unitBallVolume n) there is δ > 0 such that c · t^n ≤ μ_V(B_t(x)) for all t ∈ (0, δ); i.e. ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] 0, c · ofReal(t)^n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x t).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < ENNReal.ofReal θ * unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x t)
